findings.title: Pooled results can hide a regression in every paired round
findings.observation: The analyzer pools all calls by side and checks only same-side block spread. It does not evaluate paired A/B round differences. A deterministic synthetic input with all four paired differences +0.26 ms receives median and p95 PASS against the 0.25 ms allowance: unequal call counts yield pooled delta +0.02 ms and same-side spread 0.24 ms.
findings.minimalRepair: Retain and evaluate each paired round using the unchanged baseline-relative allowance and declared uncertainty. A consistent contrary paired regression must prevent owner PASS. Preserve per-slot summaries, counts/rates and pooled summaries; unequal frequency must remain visible. Define ambiguous or undersampled round comparisons before acquisition rather than averaging them away.
findings.control: The retained synthetic all-four-round regression must not PASS. A balanced no-regression fixture should still PASS; sparse/noisy fixtures remain INCOMPLETE. No budget or duration change.

findings.title: Custody failures do not gate owner verdicts
findings.observation: runtimeUnchanged is recorded but ignored by analysis. inputsUnchanged is computed after ANALYSIS.json is produced. The analyzer does not verify callsSha256. Synthetic records with runtimeUnchanged.B=false and inputsUnchanged=false, or a wrong raw digest, still receive owner PASS. runtime_identity.py is an imported, unpinned helper. The driver does not compare the initial complete runtime identities against the declared fixed baseline/candidate tree hashes, and post-run checks do not rebind overlays.
findings.minimalRepair: Pin the identity helper and all newly used font/fixture dependencies. Bind expected full A/B runtime identities and all overlay hashes before launch; verify served-file identities and post-run pins before any verdict. Verify every raw-file digest and failure/overflow/exception fields during analysis. Missing, failed or stale custody must yield INCOMPLETE with no numeric PASS. Retain failed bytes and the original packet.
findings.control: Mutate a runtime file, overlay, helper or raw file in an isolated synthetic control, and test missing/false post-state fields: every affected analysis must refuse PASS. No mutation of product or frozen builds is required for this control.

findings.title: The declared fixed, settled network state is not established
findings.observation: Only selected fetch hosts are replaced. Fonts and other requests can still reach live network. document.fonts.status=loaded also covers completed failures and does not prove equal font bytes. Only request-start receipt times are tested; a request that starts before the window and remains active during it is not rejected. Response errors/failures and an outstanding-request set are not captured.
findings.minimalRepair: Serve the prepared pinned font fixture consistently and fail closed on unplanned external requests. Track request start/completion/failure and active requests across readiness, warmup and capture; require no unmatched outstanding work. Bind fixed payload hashes and required loaded font faces. Keep real provider attempts and the native scene scheduler active, but serve the declared immutable cached responses and retain every attempt.
findings.control: A delayed request spanning a boundary, failed font load, unexpected external request and changed fixture hash must invalidate the relevant slot before more repetitions. Root has supplied fonts-r1/MANIFEST.json, but these exact packet bytes do not yet consume it.

findings.title: The native acquisition and five-second windows lack complete finite bounds
findings.observation: The 130-second readiness loop cannot bound one stalled page.evaluate; context creation, evaluation and cleanup have no explicit outer deadlines. asyncio.sleep(5) plus delayed evaluation can produce a much longer measured window, and the only duration assertion is >=5000. This is not a bounded exact five-second observation policy.
findings.minimalRepair: Declare finite per-slot/readiness/readback and shutdown deadlines with owned-process cleanup, retained partial data and no automatic repeat. Use an exact monotonic five-second analysis interval or a prospectively bounded boundary-lateness rule; retain actual marks and overshoot. Do not extend blocks after observing sparse samples or unfavorable results.
findings.control: With mocked hung evaluate/close and delayed boundary completion, the driver must stop, retain INCOMPLETE and release its owned resource safely. A normal slot must still contain the specified five-second actual-function warmup and five-second observation.

findings.title: Matched-state checks omit geometry and run only after warmup
findings.observation: readyState is not validated or matched before the five-second warmup. match_state checks phase displacement but not equal phase-display diameter, named render-surface sizes/view geometry or required owner registration. The synthetic control accepts a doubled phase-display diameter and an empty owners map. Fonts and .c dimensions alone do not establish the promised renderer geometry. Endpoint pending=false also does not exclude a Moon refinement started and completed inside the window.
findings.minimalRepair: Validate and match the admitted ready state before warmup and recheck boundaries. Compare the declared named geometry/quality fields, actual civil zone and essential owner coverage while allowing disclosed H1 algorithm differences and independent epoch counters. Retain and discriminate Moon render-job/message deltas across the window so unmatched heavy refinement cannot be hidden by clean endpoints. Keep normal sky refresh included.
findings.control: Wrong/missing geometry, an absent required owner, wrong civil fixture, pre-warmup mismatch and a transient Moon refinement must not receive a matched-state verdict. Same semantic state with different epoch numbers must remain eligible.

findings.title: Known retained-state and scope coverage are incomplete
findings.observation: moonDetail captures only cv/cloudCv/last/disposed. It omits the already known table, calendarTable, surface, prepared and candidate projected roots. createInitialMoon retains material/coverage/records/indices/rule but no owner is registered for them. Ordinary arrays are traversed but their lengths/capacities are not reported. registerOwner silently replaces a previous owner of the same name. Analysis starts from observed names rather than the expected source-map union, so a wholly unexecuted expected owner is omitted. Initial receiver decode/admission outside the named head callback is not identified as an uncovered startup scope.
findings.minimalRepair: Add the existing retained roots or mark exact unavailable scopes INCOMPLETE; do not capture otherwise unretained input bytes merely for observation. Report ordinary array lengths and unique buffer accounting. Retain owner-instance identity or reject unexpected duplicate registration. Drive the coverage table from both source maps, distinguishing absent, startup-only, excluded and observed owners; explicitly account for uninstrumented initial admission work.
findings.control: The projected/prefix and receiver arrays must appear with bounded identity/size or explicit uncovered status, and required duplicate/missing owners must be visible. Disposed fields must be reported separately from GC reclamation; no heap-wide claim.

findings.title: Observer preservation and uncertainty are not yet sufficient for numeric PASS
findings.observation: The RAF arrow wrapper invokes fn(t), losing the native callback receiver; Root has independently acknowledged the repair. The empty-probe uncertainty is one scalar per comparison. Exclusive parent elapsed still contains entry/exit accounting for each direct instrumented child; with different child counts between variants, one empty-probe p95 does not bound that asymmetric overhead. nestedObservedMs is collected but unused. The four deterministic recorder controls do not exercise the browser API adapters.
findings.minimalRepair: Forward the actual RAF callback receiver and test the exercised scheduling/cancellation/listener/worker/canvas adapters, including return/throw and one-shot removal behavior. Predeclare an owner-aware conservative observer bound using actual direct-child multiplicity and matched nested controls, or return INCOMPLETE wherever the available bound cannot settle a result. Keep probe allocations/references separate from product inventories and do not subtract measured overhead from product samples.
findings.control: Use lightweight adapter and synthetic nested-call controls; no browser benchmark is necessary to repair these semantics. A decision near a budget boundary that is sensitive to asymmetric child instrumentation must remain INCOMPLETE.
